title: [Master] - 'Greater Than' Withholding Tax Calculation Rule is not applied correctly in Withholding Tax Posting Setup.
summary: The 'Greater Than' withholding tax calculation rule and other rule options are now applied correctly in withholding tax posting setup by replacing hard-coded threshold checks with a rule-aware procedure.
key_points: Fixed incorrect withholding tax calculations when using rules other than 'Less than'
Created a reusable ShouldCreateWithholdingTax procedure that respects the configured calculation rule
Updated threshold checks across multiple codeunits to use the new rule-aware logic instead of hard-coded comparisons
Withholding tax is now created or suppressed based on the actual configured rule, not always the 'Less than' rule
Added comprehensive tests to verify correct behavior for all calculation rule options
quote: the other rule options (Greater than, etc.) were never honored
